foods_barcode_unique.name: foods_barcode_unique
foods_barcode_unique.where: user_id IS NULL AND barcode IS NOT NULL

foods_source_ownership.name: foods_source_ownership
foods_source_ownership.value:
("foods"."source" = 'custom' AND "foods"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("foods"."source" = 'open_food_facts' AND "foods"."user_id" IS NULL)

foods_macros_per_100g.name: foods_macros_per_100g
foods_macros_per_100g.value:
"foods"."protein_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      AND "foods"."carbs_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      AND "foods"."fat_g" BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      AND "foods"."energy_kj" BETWEEN 0 AND 4000

media_one_location.name: media_one_location
media_one_location.value:
("media_assets"."delivery" = 'r2_copy' AND "media_assets"."r2_key" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."external_url" IS NULL)
       OR ("media_assets"."delivery" = 'external_embed' AND "media_assets"."external_url" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."r2_key" IS NULL)

workout_sets_cardio_range.name: workout_sets_cardio_range
workout_sets_cardio_range.value:
("workout_sets"."duration_secs" IS NULL OR "workout_sets"."duration_secs" BETWEEN 0 AND 86400)
      AND ("workout_sets"."distance_m" IS NULL OR "workout_sets"."distance_m" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)
